_comment: EXAMPLE CONFIG. Copy this to config.local.json and edit that instead — config.local.json is gitignored and takes precedence, so your real target companies and salary floor stay private. Board tokens are the company slug in their careers URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.
_workday: Large US employers self-host on Workday. Find tenant/dc/site in the careers URL: https://<tenant>.<dc>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>. Verified working as of this commit.

adzuna._help: Free keys at https://developer.adzuna.com. The app reads them from ADZUNA_APP_ID / ADZUNA_APP_KEY (env or Streamlit secrets) — never commit real keys here.

watch._help: Used by the `watch` CLI command for the daily digest.
watch._max_age_days: Drop postings older than this many days. Keeps a rotating aggregator's stale backlog out of the 'new since last run' set. 0 disables the check; postings whose source reports no date are always kept.
watch._per_source: Cap on results from any one source, so a high-volume aggregator can't fill the whole digest.
